description: This file declares interfaces and components related to touchpad configuration management within the Cuttlefish project, including classes for sharing and parsing touchpad configs, and component registration functions.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigs
classes.description: Interface for sharing touchpad configuration data between components.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsFlag
classes.description: Class representing a flag feature for touchpad configuration parsing.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the touchpad configuration component.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets the list of touchpad configurations.
